turns.prompt: Best triple monitor laptop extender that works with a MacBook Air?
turns.answer:
If you're using a MacBook Air and want three screens total (your MacBook display + two extra screens), I'd prioritize a triple-screen extender that explicitly supports macOS and Apple Silicon.

My biggest recommendation: Don't buy a generic USB-C triple-screen extender without checking Mac compatibility. Many models are designed primarily for Windows laptops.
